name: manual_993867
claim: Stash-first discipline: before any risky git operation (rebase, history inspection, branch surgery, cross-repo sync), capture state including untracked: git status --short --branch; git stash push --include-untracked -m 'preserve work before <operation>'; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository; git config user.name; git config user.email. Never destructive cleanup until stash verified.
